# H3 DIRECTOR STUDIO V2 — START HERE

## Required before opening this workflow

- **[ComfyUI-Pixaroma](https://gitlab.com/pixaroma/comfyui-pixaroma)** — required for the visible **Render Timer** node.
- Current [ComfyUI](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI) with native MiniMax H3 support.
- [ComfyUI-H3-Motion-Context](https://github.com/NikoDemon80/ComfyUI-H3-Motion-Context) — continuity for motion and audio.
- [ComfyUI-OBVPM-Timeline](https://github.com/chanon/comfyui-obvpm-timeline) — context windows for the Upscale pass.
- A compatible **MinimaxH3LatentUpscaler3D** provider.

## Workflow node packages

- [Deno custom nodes](https://github.com/Deno2026/comfyui-deno-custom-nodes) — reference image/audio loader.
- [rgthree-comfy](https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy) — BASE and UPSCALE LoRA stacks.
- [ComfyUI-Spectrum-MiniMax-H3](https://github.com/xmarre/ComfyUI-Spectrum-MiniMax-H3) — Spectrum, wired to BASE only.
- [ComfyUI-KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes) — optional BASE preview.
- [VideoHelperSuite](https://github.com/Kosinkadink/ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite) — final MP4 output.

## Example model files shown in this workflow

- **BASE:** `Minimax-h3_Singularity_ref2va_v1.3_Pruned_w4a8.safetensors`
- **UPSCALE:** `10Eros_Max_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`
- **Video VAE:** `minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors`
- **Audio VAE:** `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors`
- **Text Encoder:** `qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors`

## Quick use

1. Add image/audio references, a global prompt and one prompt per segment.
2. **Generate clip N** with the switch on BASE to review it; then use **Keep BASE → Upscale**.
3. **Approve final → next clip** advances the selector. **Run Chain** continues automatically from the active clip.
4. Seed mode is **Randomize**. Use **Lock current seed** only when you want to repeat a result.

Spectrum is wired **only to BASE**. Use it with non-Turbo BASE sampling at around 25 steps; keep it out of the 3D latent-upscale branch.
